summary: Recent research on AI agents shows rapid progress in multi-step reasoning, tool use, and autonomous planning. Open-source models are closing the gap with proprietary systems on complex reasoning tasks.
key_findings: Chain-of-thought prompting improves task success rates by 40-60%
Tool-augmented agents outperform text-only agents on retrieval tasks
Self-reflection loops significantly reduce agent failure cascades
Open-source models now match GPT-4 on several agentic benchmarks

themes.name: Reasoning & Planning
findings: Tree-of-thought enables backtracking and plan revision
Hierarchical planning decomposes complex goals into sub-tasks

themes.name: Tool Use & Grounding
findings: Web search integration improves factual accuracy
Code execution lets agents verify mathematical claims

themes.name: Open-Source Progress
findings: Community benchmarks drive rapid model iteration
